text.wn-title:
Nano bead extensions,
explained.
text.wn-sub: What they are, how they're installed, why women choose them, and what to consider before deciding whether they're right for your hair.
text.wn-what-body: Nano bead extensions are installed one strand at a time using a tiny metal bead, about the size of a grain of rice.
text.wn-what-body2: There is no glue, tape, heat, or sewing. Because every strand is placed individually, the color, density, and placement can be customized throughout your hair.
text.wn-b1-body: Small, individual strands help distribute the weight throughout the head instead of concentrating it in one bulky attachment.
text.wn-b2-body: Tiny beads sit, discreetly near the root, making ponytails, buns, and half up styles easier to wear.
text.wn-b3-body: Because because the hair is installed straight by strand, it moves more like your own hair without the stiffness of a large weft.
text.wn-b4-body: Multiple shades can be blended throughout your set for a detailed colour match that looks natural from root to end.
text.wn-b5-body: With proper care, the same extension hair can be removed and reinstalled throughout multiple maintenance appointments.
text.wn-b6-body: Your length, fullness, placement, and number of strands are customized to your natural density and goals.
text.wn-thin-title: When your hair changes, it can change how you see yourself.
text.wn-thin-body:
Maybe you've always had fine hair. Maybe postpartum shedding, breakage, over processing, a difficult haircut, or another season of life that left you feeling like you lost a part of yourself.

It can affect how you get ready, how often you wear your hair up, how comfortable you feel in photos, and whether you recognize the woman looking back at you.
text.wn-thin-body2:
Nano bead extensions cannot undo what you've been through… But for the right candidate, they can help bring back the fullness, length, and confidence you've been missing.

Every begins with an honest assessment, because sometimes your hair needs extensions… And sometimes it needs time.
text.wn-q1: Will nano beads damage my hair?
text.wn-a1: No permanent extension method is completely risk free. When nano beads are properly installed, maintained, and worn by the right candidate, they are considered one of the gentler permanent methods. We will never add more weight than your natural hair can comfortably support.
text.wn-a2: They should not hurt. You may notice some tenderness or awareness during the first few days while your scalp adjusts, but the beads should never feel painfully tight or pull on your natural hair..
text.wn-q3: How long does the extension hair last?
text.wn-a3: With proper care, the extension hair typically lasts 9 to 18 months and can be reused to multiple maintenance appointments. Bloner shades usually fall closer to the lower end of that range because lighter hair has undergone more processing. Texture, heat use, home care, and maintenance habits can also affect the lifespan.
text.wn-q4: Are nanos right for fine hair?
text.wn-a4: They can be a great option for fine to normal density hair because the strands are so small and the placement can be customized. However, active shedding, weakened roots, or very fragile hair may mean extensions are not the right choice at that time.
